title: Celestial voyage: a star-voyage fantasy RPG's official-site grammar - deep navy star field, gold only as hairlines and the current state, a heavy CJK serif title over a hairline italic Latin ghost, gilt ticket cards and a faction orbit
summary: A deep navy star field fills every screen; gold is the only accent and appears as hairlines, underlines, card rims and the current state (about 1-5% of a section). Section titles are a heavy CJK serif with a hairline italic Latin ghost overlapping their lower third. A 75-unit black bar carries a logo that hangs 62 units out of it and a cream download tab rounded only at the bottom left. Cards are gilt-rimmed rounded frames; the character section hangs faction medallions on a huge arc whose centre sits off the left of the screen.

provenance.case: vesperwake (长庚航志 VESPERWAKE): an original one-page official site (home, news, crew, world chart and footer; 1920 and 390 wide, a ?slot=1 placeholder mode) and two in-game screens (star chart, banner), every character position carried in the default (show) mode by type, frames, data and generated textures, with no figures and no drawn pseudo-illustration, and in slot mode by a sized placeholder frame with an image-generation task sheet and a layers.json.
provenance.lineage: The official-site grammar of star-voyage fantasy RPGs (2020s): a deep navy star field, gold hairline UI, a heavy serif CJK title with a Latin ghost, a hanging logo and a cream download tab, fullpage sections, a faction orbit. Read and measured on the public reference site the owner named (screenshots, computed styles and timings with Playwright); the captures stay private and are not shipped. Borrowed: the grammar and the measured proportions. Never borrowed: any name, logo, wordmark, character, mascot, organisation, slogan, picture, vehicle silhouette or the reference's own glyph shapes.
provenance.borrow: Borrow grammar, never assets. Every name, logo, character, headline and picture in the case and the templates is our own (长庚航志, 长庚号 the star-sail ship, 岑星澜, 守夜同盟, 琥珀港); in show mode every character position is carried by the grammar itself (type, frames, data, generated textures) with no figure and no code-drawn pseudo-illustration, and in slot mode by a sized placeholder frame waiting for original art from an image-generation task sheet and its layer contract.

Slot mode and the full page: 0.

Character panel x 18-1531, y 313-915; name 52.5 units; story box 475 wide, rgba(0,0,0,.5), corners 10.5, 16.5/20.25 units #BFBFBF; avatars 87 square on a 100 pitch; faction medallions 120 across (current about 140, gold diamonds either side) on an arc of radius about 760 centred off the left, 13.7 degrees apart.

Motion: a radial warp intro (16.7 s to the bar on first load, mostly asset loading); the bar slides in over 0.5 s ease-in-out; fullpage sections on the wheel; carousels 0.6 s; the orbit turns in 0.3 s linear; the PV ring turns once in 5 s.

64 px: with logos masked the case's sections read as this grammar beside the reference and apart from street-tape (light grey and acid) and the six earlier game packs (acid-print-hud is dark but acid and chamfered).

fonts.resolve: fonts query --text-file <all copy> --style mincho --weight 900 resolves the CJK serif for head (the case's copy: Noto Serif CJK SC covers it); Cinzel and Cormorant Garamond are Latin only (fonts measure --path), so mixed CJK and Latin strings go to head or body, never label or ghost. Cormorant Garamond ships no italic file: the browser obliques it, which is the look the grammar wants for a hairline ghost.
fonts.licence: All roles use SIL OFL 1.1 fonts.
fonts.note: Fonts are named, not bundled. --font-dir <dir> reads coverage and embeds the faces.

grammar: Deep navy star field everywhere (#0B1426 with nebula haze); gold #E1B066 is the only accent and appears only as hairlines, underlines, rims, ticks and the current state (1-5% of a section); bright areas belong to the art.

A 75-unit black bar at 80%: the logo hangs 62 units below it at the left, nav items sit on a 139-unit pitch from x 353, the current item turns gold with a full-width underline, and a cream download tab (225 x 83, rounded only bottom-left) closes the right end.

Section titles at (209, 163): a heavy CJK serif in white over a hairline italic Latin ghost (stroke only, dark gold) that overlaps the CJK's lower third and may run longer than it; the home screen has none.
A left rail: a 1-unit line at x 77 broken by a column of nine social icons, with CONTACT US set vertically above them; content passes under it.

News is a horizontal row of gilt-rimmed rounded cards (626 x 518, corners 37.5 / 22.5) on a 673 pitch, the current one rimmed in gold, each with a dark caption bar and a 6 x 33 gold tick; round dark arrows with a dark-gold ring sit on the gaps; a gold-outline 'more +' capsule closes the row.

The character section is a translucent panel with the figure breaking its top and bottom, an info column (name, sign, CV with a voice button, a story box, square avatars) on the left, a serif quote on dark plates over the figure, and faction medallions on a huge arc centred off the left of the screen.
The world section is a draggable chart: dotted gold orbits, ports labelled with a diamond, a hairline leader and a serif name.

procedural: star dust (materials generate halftone, mode fm, cream ink at 2.5% coverage) and nebula haze, dotted gold orbits, medallions with a dotted inner ring and one serif character, four-point stars
ticket perforation: two half-circle bites and a dashed gold line across the top of a caption bar (the case's signature for news)
the placeholder logo mark: a gilt astrolabe ring with ticks, a tilted orbit and a four-point star (no crescent, no comet stroke)
recipes: A star field under a picture or a placeholder: materials generate --generator halftone --params '{"mode":"fm","periodPx":6,"coverage":0.025,"ink":"#F7E8CC","paper":"none"}' --seed 4, tiled at 512 and laid at 22% in screen mode over the navy sky (the case's star dust).

News covers and passes without art: a printed ink flat (materials generate --generator print --params '{"ink":"#14213F","paper":"laid-cream","margin":0}') under a big serif keyword and an issue number, and a paper stub (materials generate --generator paper --params '{"profile":"laid-cream"}') carrying the category: real texture, live type, no drawn picture.

Characters and key art come from an image-generation task sheet (#311): one sheet per frame with its size, safe box, the boxes left for UI, a warm lantern key with an ice rim, the palette and 'original characters only'; until then the frame shows its size and safe box, and a cut-out goes in with materials cut --mode none --finish cut, blended painted-in (grade, light wrap, a star-tide occluder) per composite/*.layers.json.
collage: Pictures sit only inside gilt-rimmed rounded frames or behind the panel; text on a picture always sits on a dark caption bar or plate.
materials.sources: Everything is drawn; pictures are your own art in the image slots.

grammar: A radial warp intro (streaks accelerating from the centre, gold and ice) before the first screen; keep it under 3 s and skippable (the reference waits on assets for up to 17 s).
The top bar slides down and fades in over 0.5 s ease-in-out after the intro; sections snap one screen per wheel step and the current nav item follows.

Carousels move in 0.6 s on cubic-bezier(.15,.59,.45,.89); the faction orbit turns in 0.3 s linear; the PV ring turns once every 5 s; key-art rings turn slowly (90-160 s) and lantern lights rise over 14 s.
motion.flashLimit: No flashing; the news row advances every 6.5 s and pauses on hover.

guidance: 64 px distinctiveness (guidance): shrink each screen to 64 px tall beside street-tape and the six earlier game packs with the logo masked; the navy field, the gold hairline bar and the cream tab at top right, and the row of rimmed cards or the orbit arc should still read. A grey or acid page reads as street-tape or acid-print-hud instead.

Show mode without figures (guidance): carry each screen with the grammar - the serif title and its ghost, gilt frames, data (dates, routes, stats), live UI and textures from materials generate - and keep drawn objects abstract (orbit lines, ticks, four-point stars). Code-drawn pseudo-illustration (props, mascots, scenery) reads cheap next to a reference carried by painted art; leave that to generated art dropped in through the layer contract.
The Latin ghost overlaps its CJK title by design: give both one data-grp prefix (t-news/zh, t-news/en) and mark the ghost data-deco, or the browser check reports text-overlap.
Cards and ports that bleed off the screen edge are design, not error: hide their captions (opacity 0) at the edges and fade off-screen ports, or the browser check reports off-canvas.
A currency pill that holds an icon, a value and a plus is three units: wrap the value in its own element, or the check measures the plus's cream disc against the pill.
Never set a mixed CJK and Latin string in Cinzel or Cormorant Garamond: use head or body (glyph coverage).
checks.note: The browser check runs on every render (the ghost, the bites and the orbit are measured in pixels).

examples.note: Renders of the case that stay examples (outside the repository, with the owner): the four sections at 1920 x 1080, the full page, the 390-wide page, slot mode and the two in-game screens.
